title: LongBench-v2 Dataset Construction and Evaluation Protocol

nodes.label:
97 Qualified Annotators
Screened native English and bilingual domain experts
Trained with strict guidelines on long-context QA authoring

English Document Ingestion
Academic papers, legal books, literature, and technical reports
Diverse high-quality long-context text sources

PyMuPDF Text Extraction & Parsing
Extract clean linear text stream from PDF/HTML documents
Filter formatting noise, tables, and OCR artifacts

Length & Deduplication Gate
Enforce minimum length threshold (>8,192 words)
MinHash deduplication against standard benchmarks

Document Rejection
Discard short, malformed, or repetitive documents
Log rejection criteria for pipeline auditing

MCQ Generation & Evidence Anchoring
Create challenging 4-choice questions
Pinpoint multi-hop evidence sentences across context

3-Model & 24-Reviewer Quality Gate
Frontier LLM screen (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5)
Independent domain expert blind cross-validation

Iterative Revision Loop (<= 5 Rounds)
Annotator refines question wording and distractors
Filter questions solvable by short-context heuristics

Question Termination (> 5 Revisions)
Permanently drop questions exceeding revision budget
Maintain rigorous quality control threshold

503 Validated English MCQs
Final frozen LongBench-v2 evaluation dataset
Balanced distribution across lengths (8k to 128k words)

Long-Context Prompt Assembly
Standardized prompt format with full context & question
Support zero-shot and few-shot evaluation regimes

Model Context Processing & Generation
Evaluate models over 8K-128K context windows
Extract predicted option letter (A, B, C, D)

Accuracy Scoring & Stratification
Compute overall accuracy across 6 core categories
Stratify performance across context length tiers

LongBench-v2 Leaderboard Report
Effective context window capacity ratings
Hard long-context reasoning benchmark freeze
